mapper.sql: b.BILL_ID, b.BILL_NO, b.BILL_TYPE, b.SUPPLIER_ID, b.AMOUNT, b.ISSUE_DATE, b.DUE_DATE, b.STATUS, b.BANK_NAME, b.BANK_ACCOUNT, b.DRAWER, b.PAYEE, b.DESCRIPTION, b.REMARKS, b.AUDIT_STATUS, b.CREATE_TIME, b.CREATE_BY, s.SUPPLIER_NAME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_PAYABLE_BILL b LEFT JOIN TBL_SUPPLIER s ON b.SUPPLIER_ID = s.SUPPLIER_ID WHERE b.BILL_ID = #{billId} AND b.IS_DELETED = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(AMOUNT), 0) as totalAmount, COUNT(*) as totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'active' THEN AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) as activeAmount FROM TBL_PAYABLE_BILL WHERE IS_DELETED = 0

SELECT FROM TBL_PAYABLE_BILL b LEFT JOIN TBL_SUPPLIER s ON b.SUPPLIER_ID = s.SUPPLIER_ID WHERE b.IS_DELETED = 0 AND b.STATUS = 'active' AND b.DUE_DATE BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) + #{days} ORDER BY b.DUE_DATE ASC
SELECT FROM TBL_PAYABLE_BILL b LEFT JOIN TBL_SUPPLIER s ON b.SUPPLIER_ID = s.SUPPLIER_ID WHERE b.SUPPLIER_ID = #{supplierId} AND b.IS_DELETED = 0 ORDER BY b.CREATE_TIME DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_PAYABLE_BILL SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHERE BILL_ID = #{billId}
